provinceDeepAtlasProfile.oneLine: Kaelvorrin is centered at 6.383293, 5.827743 under Consensus Democracy, with 133,180,000 people across 9 settlements.
provinceDeepAtlasProfile.extremeAtlasDescription: Kaelvorrin occupies 5,610,032.72 sq mi / 14,529,918.04 sq km of modeled Earth-sized territory, about 2.848636% of Belavadös's surface. It is not merely a province but a continent-scale civic machine: Farming, Partial forest and Grassland define its broad terrain, while its settlements intensify into Farming and Partial forest. Population density is 9.166 people/sq km / 23.740 people/sq mi, which lets wilderness, roads, faction-held corridors, and vast uncrowded borders remain huge.
provinceDeepAtlasProfile.peopleFactionsAndFaith: The strongest public people-groups are Humans, Near-Humans, and Mixed Heritage, Halfling and Smallfolk, Animalfolk and Mammalian Anthropomorphs, Dwarven and Gnomish Kin, Amphibious and Aquatic Peoples, Elf Parent Race and Elf Bloodlines, and 1 more. Frequently recorded peoples include Human, Halfling — Lightfoot Halfling, Halfling — Stout Halfling, Kender, Kithkin, Harengon, Centaur, Giff, and 4 more. Faction visibility leans toward The Brass Concordat, with worship and patronage records naming Nebyrr, Ishtanora, Iskareth, Marduthor, Raeshkul, Bastveig, Sigrananna, and 3 more.
provinceDeepAtlasProfile.groupLinkDescription: The province participates in 7 recorded four-province geography group links, including 5 cross-transportation-group links. These links place it inside overlapping regional corridors rather than one isolated block, allowing border-adjacent transit, faction influence, and cultural spillover to breathe across group lines.

npcs.name: Archivist Thiblee Jannar
npcs.description:
Archivist Thiblee Jannar is a brilliant, anxious Tiefling lore-proctor with a talent for arcane systems, construct interfaces, archive wards, and accidentally activating exactly the wrong failsafe at the worst possible time. He/them is socially awkward, over-eager, and sometimes oblivious to how dangerous his curiosity can become, but his intelligence is real, especially when repairing sentient machinery, decoding relic protocols, or building safer ways to catalogue ichor-tainted artifacts.
At the Kael'vyrûn Market Hall, Thiblee works for the Crucible Wardens maintaining relic inventories, automated archive assistants, restricted research ledgers, and containment records for ichor-powered devices. He is deeply devoted to his spouse, Scribe Paelyn Jannar, who helps keep him grounded when ambition, insecurity, or a very tempting glowing button threatens to turn “one quick upgrade” into a citywide emergency.
npcs.settlementAndAncestryTexture: Kael'vyrûn is a City in Kaelvorrin, under Consensus Democracy, with moderate danger, Farming, Partial forest, Marshes and swamps terrain. Local records favor Altruistic, Lawful, Cooperative, Honorable civic habits; common communities include Human, Halfling — Lightfoot Halfling, Halfling — Stout Halfling, Kender, Kithkin. Tiefling reads through the Tiefling entry of the race compendium, within Celestial, Fiendish, and Planar Bloodlines, marked by Freyseth. Tieflings are fiend-touched humanoids marked by infernal ancestry and social stigma. They often develop strong individuality and resilience in the face of prejudice. Table cues: Darkvision, Fiendish Legacy, Otherworldly Presence; starting tendency Neutral - Chaotic - Neutral - Neutral.
rumors: Archivist Thiblee Jannar knows why an ichor ledger changed hands last Sigranday.
Archivist Thiblee Jannar has a contact in Aelthéon who will deny everything.
plotHooks: Archivist Thiblee Jannar asks the party to protect a household member without revealing why.
A rival faction offers proof that Archivist Thiblee Jannar's public story is incomplete.
